_note: The straits whose control can choke trade (GAME_DESIGN §5). A country's own exposure is in countries.json (chokepoints); worldTradeShare is the share of the world's trade of that resource that passes, for the text.

items.name: Strait of Hormuz
items.blurb: The only sea exit of the Gulf: about a fifth of the world's oil passes here.

items.name: Suez Canal
items.blurb: Links the Red Sea and the Mediterranean; the pipelines beside it carry oil too.

items.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
items.blurb: The narrow gate between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean.
